related.title: Kubernetes：requests、limits與排程可容納性
related.titleEn: Kubernetes: requests, limits and scheduling capacity
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 layers.csv、兩個manifest和共享/不共享層的圖。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver layers.csv, two manifests and a shared-layer diagram.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 逐Pod扣除兩種資源，原組態記憶體先耗盡，只能8個；新組態CPU先限制為6個。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Subtract both resources Pod by Pod: memory limits the original case to8, while CPU limits the changed case to6. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 80+20+5+80+20+7 = 212 MiB；對照 80+20+5+7 = 112 MiB。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
建立manifest→digest→size對照，唯一digest四個；總量112 MiB，兩個映像各自邏輯大小105與107 MiB。

基準 min(floor(8000/750),floor(8192/1024)) = 8 pods；對照 min(floor(8000/1200),floor(8192/1024)) = 6 pods。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐Pod扣除兩種資源，原組態記憶體先耗盡，只能8個；新組態CPU先限制為6個。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 80+20+5+80+20+7 = 212 MiB; comparison 80+20+5+7 = 112 MiB. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Build manifest-to-digest-to-size mappings; four unique digests total112 MiB, while logical image sizes remain105 and107 MiB.

Baseline min(floor(8000/750),floor(8192/1024)) = 8 pods; comparison min(floor(8000/1200),floor(8192/1024)) = 6 pods. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Subtract both resources Pod by Pod: memory limits the original case to8, while CPU limits the changed case to6.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Prometheus：counter重設與速率解讀
related.titleEn: Prometheus: counter resets and rate interpretation
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 layers.csv、兩個manifest和共享/不共享層的圖。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver layers.csv, two manifests and a shared-layer diagram.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 逐區間增量為10、6、14，共30事件；手算觀察窗平均為1/s。另記重設時刻未知，所以這是明示假設下估計。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Interval increments are10,6,14,total30,so the observed-window mean is1/s; the unknown reset time makes this an assumption-dependent estimate. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 80+20+5+80+20+7 = 212 MiB；對照 80+20+5+7 = 112 MiB。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
建立manifest→digest→size對照，唯一digest四個；總量112 MiB，兩個映像各自邏輯大小105與107 MiB。

基準 (20-90)/30 = -2.3333333333333335 events/s；對照 (100-90+6+20-6)/30 = 1 events/s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐區間增量為10、6、14，共30事件；手算觀察窗平均為1/s。另記重設時刻未知，所以這是明示假設下估計。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 80+20+5+80+20+7 = 212 MiB; comparison 80+20+5+7 = 112 MiB. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Build manifest-to-digest-to-size mappings; four unique digests total112 MiB, while logical image sizes remain105 and107 MiB.

Baseline (20-90)/30 = -2.3333333333333335 events/s; comparison (100-90+6+20-6)/30 = 1 events/s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Interval increments are10,6,14,total30,so the observed-window mean is1/s; the unknown reset time makes this an assumption-dependent estimate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
